facts_of_case: The applicant sought transfer of case file No. 31/HM titled ' Bishan Dass v. Sushma Kumari' filed by the respondent under section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1980, pending before the court of learned District Judge Kathua to the Additional District Judge (Matrimonial Cases) Jammu.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to appear and contest the petition.
legal_principles.held: However, the respondent has not appeared in the matter.

legal_principles.principle: A petition remains pending until it is disposed of or withdrawn.
legal_principles.held: This petition was filed in the year 2016 and has remained pending in this Court.

outcome.final_order: The petition was disposed of as infructuous and a copy of this order be sent to the applicant at the address disclosed on the petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1980.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of case in matrimonial disputes
advising on the procedure for filing an application under section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
assisting with notice to respondent in divorce proceedings
